locator.quote: Treat comparisons as bounded-error queries to a fixed tournament

findings.finding: The directed three-cycle offered in this row is not a counterexample to the stated shortcut: a deterministic cyclic tournament is still a fixed tournament and its comparisons have zero error. locator.section: 6. The Forrelation lower bound

findings.finding: The interpolated object is described inaccurately. In the record, the law of every Gaussian layer remains fixed; the parameter multiplies only the first block of the conditional sign biases.
